title: Short Weekend Escapes (Within 200 km from Delhi)
content:
If you’re craving a short break but don’t want to travel too far, there are plenty of weekend destinations near Delhi within 200 km. From peaceful lakesides to royal towns and spiritual getaways — these spots are perfect for quick rejuvenation.

1. Neemrana Fort Palace (125 km)

Highlights: Heritage fort, luxury stay, zip-lining, candlelight dinners.
Route: Delhi – Gurgaon – Neemrana (NH48).
Best Time to Visit: October to March.
2-Day Itinerary:

Day 1: Drive to Neemrana, check-in to Neemrana Fort Palace, enjoy fort exploration and spa.

Day 2: Try zip-lining and relax by the pool before returning to Delhi.

2. Damdama Lake (60 km)

Highlights: Boating, adventure sports, picnic spot.
Route: Delhi – Gurgaon – Sohna – Damdama Lake.
Best Time to Visit: October to March.
2-Day Itinerary:

Day 1: Morning drive, enjoy boating, rock climbing, and lunch by the lake.

Day 2: Early morning bird watching and return to Delhi.

3. Sohna (65 km)

Highlights: Hot springs, spa resorts, nature retreat.
Route: Delhi – Gurgaon – Sohna.
Best Time to Visit: October to February.
2-Day Itinerary:

Day 1: Arrive at Sohna, visit the hot springs and enjoy a resort stay.

Day 2: Take a short trek or explore Damdama Lake before heading back.

4. Alwar (165 km)

Highlights: Alwar Fort, Siliserh Lake, Bhangarh Fort (haunted site).
Route: Delhi – Dharuhera – Alwar.
Best Time to Visit: October to March.
3-Day Itinerary:

Day 1: Drive to Alwar, visit Bala Quila Fort and City Palace.

Day 2: Explore Siliserh Lake and Bhangarh Fort.

Day 3: Visit Sariska Wildlife Sanctuary and drive back to Delhi.

5. Mathura & Vrindavan (180 km)

Highlights: Temples, spiritual aura, Krishna Janmabhoomi, evening aarti.
Route: Delhi - Faridabad - Mathura.
Best Time to Visit: November to March, Janmashtami festival.
2-Day Itinerary:

Day 1: Visit Krishna Janmabhoomi Temple, Dwarkadheesh Temple.

Day 2: Explore Vrindavan’s Banke Bihari Temple and ISKCON Temple, then return.

6. Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary (Keoladeo National Park) (180 km)

Highlights: UNESCO World Heritage Site, bird watching, photography.
Route: Delhi - Mathura - Bharatpur.
Best Time to Visit: November to February.
2-Day Itinerary:

Day 1: Drive to Bharatpur, enjoy bird watching inside the park.

Day 2: Visit Lohagarh Fort and Government Museum before heading back.
excerpt: Discover peaceful weekend escapes near Delhi under 200 km - from royal forts like Neemrana to serene lakes like Damdama and bird havens like Bharatpur. Perfect for short breaks, these destinations offer relaxation, nature, and cultural charm.
